'''March 2001 Raleigh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Games Galore, Raleigh, NC on 3 March 2001. [[Mike Merletto]] won it. It is known from Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1829">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-raleigh-nc-3-3-01d1829/ raleigh-nc-3-3-01], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 4 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-raleigh-nc-3-3-01d1829/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Games Galore, Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Merletto]]
